meta.name: Pluto TV Franchise Favorites
meta.description:
Why watch one awesome Hollywood blockbuster when you could watch three (or more)? Pluto TV Franchise Favorites brings you top-tier movie series playing back-to-back any time of day, but only for a limited time.

Shows: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood, Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan, Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
Available on: Pluto TV
